gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Noto Sans Gothic has big round lowercase, like glass beads. Quilon above it swells and tapers like glass rods, and that shared roundness with a shifting stroke is the pair's best trick.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Sharp and a bit regal, Quilon leads with a gently shifting stroke, while Noto Sans Grantha follows in tall, open-bowled letters that never snag. Quilon earns its place big and brief.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Quilon's stroke swells and thins in a slow, steady rhythm. Noto Sans Gujarati follows with curved strokes that stop before turning inward, so the headline feels dressed and the text feels easy.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-gondi: Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi stands tall, its lowercase strokes thick as crayon marks. Under Quilon's medium contrast and soft hairlines, Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi would read as a steady, open run of text, with terminals cut back to leave generous gaps.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Noto Sans Gurmukhi sends its terminals outward like tongs, with ascenders that barely clear the x-height. Quilon is the one to bring a rhythm of soft heavier accents, while Noto Sans Gurmukhi simply keeps each line tidy and plain.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Easy and open, with lowercase filling most of the line's height. Noto Sans Hanunoo gives Quilon's editorial, tapering strokes a plain, contemporary partner that lets the heading do the talking.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Noto Sans Hebrew reads with a dominant midsection and wide gaps between curve ends and stems, so lines feel spacious and modern. Text flows smoothly beneath Quilon.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-hk: Quilon's low-to-medium contrast gives it a commanding, editorial pull. It handles the headline, while Noto Sans HK, with its large lowercase and lifted brush ends, simply carries the words without fuss.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-imperial-aram: Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic reads friendly, its c ends pointing apart like pincers. Quilon, steady yet faintly modulated, earns its keep when set big and short, with the text font keeping things approachable underneath.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-inscriptional: Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian has big open eyes and a deep middle band. Quilon, with its subtle pen-like modulation in the bowls, earns its keep when set big and short above it.
